findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes only raw Django views with SQL injection-vulnerable endpoints. No REST API, GraphQL, or documented interface exists. Integration requires UI automation or direct database access.
findings.gap: No documented, stable API interface for agent tool binding.
findings.recommendation: Implement a proper REST API using Django REST Framework with documented JSON endpoints.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: No idempotency controls exist on any operation. Write operations would produce duplicates on agent retry.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism for write operations.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key support to write endpoints and enforce unique constraints on business keys.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency keys or deduplication logic.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The ticketing system is a write-enabled CRUD application. Agent retries on write endpoints without idempotency keys would create duplicate tickets.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add idempotency key header support to write endpoints
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write endpoints accept idempotency keys with at-most-once semantics

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Only Django session-based authentication exists. No service account, API key, OAuth2 client credentials, or mTLS mechanism for agent authentication.
findings.gap: Agents cannot authenticate to this system. Only human session-based auth exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key authentication or OAuth2 client credentials flow for machine identities.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. Only a print statement for debugging. Write operations leave no attributable audit trail.
findings.gap: No audit logging of authenticated principals for write operations. No immutable log storage.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with immutable storage (CloudWatch Logs with retention or S3 Object Lock).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents require immutable audit trails for compliance. This system has zero audit logging — not even application-level access logs.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanism exists. Raw SQL without transaction management. Multi-step workflows that fail mid-sequence leave partial state.
findings.gap: No rollback or compensation logic for multi-step operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement database transactions and compensating actions for multi-step workflows.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no transaction management or compensation logic.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The CRUD ticketing system uses raw SQL without transaction boundaries. Agent-initiated multi-step operations (create ticket + assign + notify) cannot be rolled back on failure.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Unscoped in API Responses
findings.description: System stores user PII (requester names, ticket content). API responses include all fields without filtering. No access control differentiation. No classification metadata.
findings.gap: Sensitive fields (requester PII) exposed in all API responses without scoping.
findings.recommendation: Implement response DTOs with field-level access controls. Exclude sensitive fields from agent-consumable endpoints.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired — sensitive fields returned without filtering.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The ticket_list view returns requester names (PII) to any caller without field-level filtering. A write-enabled agent consuming these endpoints receives sensitive data it has no business retrieving.

b1.reasoning: ticket_list returns requester PII in general API responses with no field filtering or separate DTOs.

b2.reasoning: Single Django session auth — no differentiation between sensitive and non-sensitive data access.

b3.reasoning: No classification metadata, tags, or sensitivity annotations exist.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: No data residency controls exist. PostgreSQL on single EC2 with no region constraints. Internal employee data stored without residency policy.
findings.gap: No controls preventing agent data transmission across jurisdictions.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements and implement region-locking for the data store.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no residency controls for employee PII.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores internal employee data (requester names, ticket content) with no documented residency requirements or controls. A write-enabled agent could transmit this data to an LLM endpoint in any jurisdiction.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: No fine-grained permission model. All authenticated users share the same access level. No IAM policies, no role differentiation.
findings.gap: Cannot grant an agent read-only access to specific resources without broader privileges.
findings.recommendation: Implement fine-grained permission model with resource-level access controls.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No permission checks in views. Any authenticated user can execute any operation without action-level enforcement.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce read-but-not-delete for an agent identity within the same resource type.
findings.recommendation: Add action-level permission decorators to all views.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No JWT, OAuth2, or token exchange mechanism. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No identity propagation through service calls.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 token exchange with user context delegation.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: Database password ('helpdesk2012') and Django SECRET_KEY committed to settings.py in plaintext. No secrets management system.
findings.gap: Credentials embedded in version-controlled source code.
findings.recommendation: Migrate all secrets to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. Only session-based auth exists.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without affecting the broader platform.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key-based authentication with revocation endpoint.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic or pessimistic locking. No version fields, ETags, or conditional writes. Concurrent agent writes would corrupt data.
findings.gap: No mechanism to prevent race conditions from concurrent agent instances.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking with version fields and ETag-based conditional updates.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations for external dependencies (PostgreSQL, SMTP).
findings.gap: External dependency failures cascade to agent callers without protection.
findings.recommendation: Implement circuit breaker patterns with configurable timeouts and fallback behavior.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, WAF, or application-level rate limiting middleware.
findings.gap: Agent traffic storms can overwhelm the single EC2 instance at machine speed.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with throttling or add django-ratelimit middleware.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits or blast radius controls. No caps on records modified, spend, or bulk operations per agent session.
findings.gap: Agent errors have unbounded blast radius.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-caller business transaction limits configurable per agent identity.

findings.title: PII Logged Without Redaction
findings.description: User search queries logged via print statement without redaction. Ticket data with requester PII returned without filtering.
findings.gap: PII logged in plaintext with no redaction.
findings.recommendation: Remove debug print statements. Implement structured logging with PII redaction middleware.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state mechanism. All writes are immediately committed with no reviewable intermediate state.
findings.gap: Agent cannot propose changes for human review before committing.
findings.recommendation: Add DRAFT/PENDING_REVIEW status states to the ticket model.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No mechanism to require human approval before executing specific operations.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk agent actions.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates per operation type.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy model found in the repository.
findings.gap: No machine-readable specification for agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI spec from API implementation after migrating to Django REST Framework.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error responses. DEBUG=True leaks stack traces. No error codes or retryable indicators.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement consistent JSON error responses with error code, message, and retryable flag.

findings.title: Unsafe State Query Mechanism
findings.description: Basic query views exist but are SQL injection-vulnerable and return HTML. Not a safe or structured state inspection API.
findings.gap: No safe, structured state query mechanism for agents.
findings.recommendation: Implement secure JSON GET endpoints for state inspection with parameterized queries.

findings.title: No Pagination or Result Limiting
findings.description: No pagination, filtering limits, or result size caps on query endpoints. Queries return unbounded result sets.
findings.gap: Unbounded result sets exhaust LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement pagination with configurable maximum page sizes.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerable
findings.description: No input validation. User input directly interpolated into SQL via string formatting. SQL injection vulnerabilities in both endpoints.
findings.gap: Arbitrary input accepted without validation. Active SQL injection vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Replace string formatting with parameterized queries. Add input validation middleware.

findings.title: Incomplete Temporal Metadata
findings.description: Only 'created' field exists. No 'updated_at'. Timezone is America/New_York (not UTC). No freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Incomplete temporal metadata. No UTC normalization. No data freshness signals.
findings.recommendation: Add updated_at timestamps, normalize to UTC, include freshness headers in responses.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no database migrations, no API contracts, no breaking change detection tools.
findings.gap: Agent tool bindings will break silently on any schema change.
findings.recommendation: Implement Django migrations, API versioning, and breaking change detection in CI.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, trace propagation, JSON logging, or correlation IDs. Only a Python 2 print statement.
findings.gap: Cannot debug agent-initiated requests.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry with X-Ray exporter and structured JSON logging.

findings.title: No Alerting Configuration
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms, anomaly detection, or monitoring infrastructure of any kind.
findings.gap: Target system degradation is invisible to operators.
findings.recommendation: Deploy CloudWatch alarms on error rates and p99 latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC exists. Manually managed single EC2 instance. No peer review, no drift detection.
findings.gap: Infrastructure changes are manual and unaudited.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure as Terraform/CDK. Enable AWS Config for drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Deployment is manual git pull + Apache restart.
findings.gap: No automated testing or contract validation before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated tests and contract validation.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No automated rollback. No blue/green, canary, feature flags, or CodeDeploy configuration.
findings.gap: Cannot quickly recover from a bad deployment.
findings.recommendation: Implement blue/green deployment with automated rollback triggers.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No tests in the repository. Zero automated test coverage for APIs.
findings.gap: API behavior changes go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Implement API test suite with pytest/Django test client in CI.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. PostgreSQL on local disk without KMS or EBS encryption.
findings.gap: Data breach exposes all ticket data including PII.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS with KMS-encrypted storage. Enable EBS encryption.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Only production on a single EC2 instance.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with Docker Compose for local agent testing.

findings.title: HTML Response Format
findings.description: Responses are raw HTML (render_to_response and string concatenation). No JSON serialization for LLM consumption.
findings.gap: HTML responses require parsing; not suitable for agent tool consumption.
findings.recommendation: Migrate all endpoints to return structured JSON responses.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No webhooks, SNS, EventBridge, Kafka, or CDC pipelines. State changes produce no observable events.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react proactively to ticket state changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement event publishing (SNS/EventBridge) for ticket lifecycle changes.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limits documented and no rate limit headers returned in responses.
findings.gap: Agents have no mechanism to self-throttle based on server capacity.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits and return X-RateLimit headers after implementing STATE-Q5.

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality monitoring, profiling, or freshness SLAs.
findings.gap: No quality guarantees on data agents will consume.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality checks and expose freshness metadata.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, schema documentation, or metadata layer describing what data the system holds.
findings.gap: Building agent tools requires reverse-engineering the data model from code.
findings.recommendation: Document the data model and consider integrating with a data catalog service.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations >30s or long-running workflows in this simple helpdesk CRUD application.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority assigned and no evidence of critical-path dependency.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names in SQL (id, subject, requester, priority, status, created) are human-readable and semantically meaningful. No legacy abbreviations requiring a data dictionary.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry of any kind — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Establish machine identity, API layer, audit logging, input validation, and credential management.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Build observability, CI/CD, infrastructure governance, and human-in-the-loop capabilities.
Address informational findings and remaining quality improvements. Structured responses, event emission, test coverage, and data catalog.

recommended_actions.action: Implement REST API with Django REST Framework
recommended_actions.rationale: The application has no API layer suitable for agent integration. Replacing raw SQL views with a proper REST API unblocks all API-related findings.
No machine identity mechanism exists. Agents cannot authenticate, and no scoped or action-level authorization is possible without an identity foundation.
Write-enabled agents require full audit attribution. No audit trail currently exists.

recommended_actions.action: Migrate secrets to AWS Secrets Manager
recommended_actions.rationale: Hardcoded credentials in source code are immediately exploitable via prompt injection or repository access.

recommended_actions.action: Fix SQL injection and add input validation
recommended_actions.rationale: Active SQL injection vulnerabilities in both views create immediate security risk regardless of agent integration.
Manual deployment with no rollback capability makes the system unsafe for any automated operation.
